item.title: Nicole Kidman Tells A$AP Rocky She’d Swap Lives With Him for Rihanna: ‘I’d Get to Kiss Your Wife’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to Trending, the podcast where we dive into the latest celebrity news and trends. Today, we're talking about a hilarious exchange between Nicole Kidman and A$AP Rocky.
[Short music transition]
Host: It all started when Vogue asked Rocky what he'd do if he could swap lives with Kidman. His response? He'd "definitely steal whatever the hell is in her closet." But Kidman had a much more interesting answer when asked the same question. She said she'd "get to kiss your wife" - and by that, she means Rihanna.
[Short music transition]
Host: Rocky burst out laughing at the response, saying "Yo! You got it" and "Nothing tops that. That was fire." It's clear that Rocky is a devoted partner to Rihanna, with whom he shares three young kids. In a recent interview with W magazine, he even gushed about how Rihanna has changed and how she remains the same charming and genuine person he adores.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today's episode of Trending. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one. Don't forget to check out the video of Kidman and Rocky's conversation on our social media channels. [Outro music continues to play]
